name: tia_create_tagtable_group
description: Create a PLC tag-table group under an exact parent path; existing names are never overwritten.

group_name.description: Name for the new tag-table group.

plc_name.description: Exact PLC software name; required when the project has multiple PLCs.

parent_group_path.description: Exact parent group path; omit or use an empty string for the root group.
